# CORE-DEC-01

**Is each significant decision recorded with its alternatives and rationale?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | DEC: Decisions and open questions |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `decisions` |

## Rule

Every decision with status accepted has chosen, at least one alternative and rationale.

## Sources

- ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022, Architecture description (`iso42010`)
- Michael Nygard, Documenting Architecture Decisions (2011) (`nygard`)
- The Open Group, TOGAF Standard 10th Edition, ADM Techniques, Trade-offs (`togaf-tradeoffs`)
